office: North Carolina State Board of Elections

feeds.what: every contest the state reports at the statewide level (federal, legislature, judicial, statewide measures, multi-county local), one row per candidate/choice
feeds.notes: JSON array served as text/plain. URL is enr/<YYYYMMDD>/data/results_<county id>.txt; county id 0 is the state, 1..100 are counties (ids in county.txt). The page appends ?v=<day-hour-minute> as a cache buster. A flat array: one object per candidate, the contest repeated on every row (cnm title, gid/lid contest id, vfr vote-for, prt/ptl precincts, ogl office group, ref 1 for a referendum). Last-Modified was Tue, 10 Nov 2026 23:05:33 GMT.

feeds.notes: Linked from https://er.ncsbe.gov/downloads.html as 'Election Night Media Results' (tab-separated, layout at http://dl.ncsbe.gov/ENRS/layout_results_pct.txt). Not downloaded; HEAD only.

election_id: The election date as YYYYMMDD (20261103) in the path enr/20261103/data/; the page URL uses election_dt=11/03/2026.
discovery: GET https://er.ncsbe.gov/enr/elections.txt lists every election date (edt, MM/DD/YYYY), newest first; turn the date into YYYYMMDD for the data folder.
cors: '*' (access-control-allow-origin: *, access-control-allow-methods: GET) when CloudFront misses its cache; some cached answers ('x-cache: RefreshHit from cloudfront') came back with no CORS header at all for the same Origin request. Adding a ?v= cache buster got the header back. So: present but not reliable from cache.
bot_blocking: None. Relay User-Agent got 200 on every file (behind Cloudflare in front of CloudFront/S3, no challenge). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: county.txt row cid=0: "imp":"November 10, 2026 6:00 pm" (last import) and "sub":"November 10, 2026 6:03 pm" (published). No zone in the value; North Carolina is Eastern time. results_0.txt has no timestamp; the HTTP Last-Modified header is the other signal.
reporting_field: On every results row: prt (precincts reported) and ptl (precincts total) for that contest, e.g. "prt":"290","ptl":"290". Statewide in county.txt row 0: prt 2626, ptl 2626, ppt "100.00%", bct ballots cast 4237426, rtl registered 7885046.
